findings.message: Dispatch now calls sender.Send(ctx, message), but the shown Sender.Send signature is still Send(text string) error and no updated Send definition appears in this change; as written this will not compile/match the callee contract.
findings.suggestion: Update Sender.Send to accept context (e.g. Send(ctx context.Context, text string) error) and use ctx for the HTTP request, or revert the call site if Send is intentionally unchanged.
